title: fix(plugin-charts): a scatter chart notes each yAxis entry after the first (objectui#10721)
body:
Fixes #10721

Clause-②: no

## What

A `scatter` chart draws one value axis, the first `yAxis` entry's. Every entry after the first now gets a `y-axis-undrawn` note under the plot, in the `ChartFootnote` channel objectui#10691 added. The note names `yAxis[N]` and the axis the chart draws, `yAxis[0]`. This follows triage `5851670156`: say so, don't narrow. The accepted `yAxis` count does not move, and nothing new is refused.

## How

- `placeYAxes` (in `normalizeChartSchema.ts`) now takes the chart family instead of the `valueAxesRunAcross` boolean. It derives two rules itself: the `horizontal-bar` run-across rule, and the scatter slice (one entry placed on `scatter`, two elsewhere). The renderer no longer slices `yAxes` for scatter before the call, so the `undrawn` list carries every entry after the first.
- On `scatter`, an undrawn entry is bound to the one slot drawn (`slotOf[0]`). A scatter reads no series binding and measures its one series against that axis. The two-slot families keep `'right'`.
- `yAxisUndrawnNotes` (in `AdvancedChartImpl.tsx`) reads the one-axis case off the placement: an entry is undrawn only once every slot is taken, so `slotOf.length === 1`. It writes: `yAxis[N]` is not drawn — this chart draws one value axis, `yAxis[0]`. On scatter the note has no derived-series clause. With neither `series` nor `categories`, two entries that carry a `field` are refused (`scatter-multi-series`), so "its field is plotted against …" would be false there.
- All three callers pass their own family: the renderer's `yPlacement`, the numeric-value guard `hasNoNumericSeriesValue`, and the normalizer's derived-series binding. The objectui#10691 pin makes two direct calls; they change from `false` to `'bar'`.
- Docs: one sentence added to the `yAxis` paragraph of `content/docs/plugins/plugin-charts.mdx`. Changeset: `.changeset/10721-scatter-yaxis-note.md`, `patch` for `@object-ui/plugin-charts`, citing objectui#10721 and objectui#10691.

Nothing published changes. `placeYAxes`, `YAxisPlacement` and `YAxisUndrawnNote` are module-internal. The package `index.ts` names only `normalizeChartSchema` and `NormalizedChartSchema`, and `exports` is `.` only.

## Hypotheses, measured

- **H1: confirmed** on base `5c61e5241`. A scatter with `xAxis` `cost`, three `yAxis` entries and one authored `series` drew 0 notes and no `data-chart-error`.
- **H2: three callers, not two.** Here is each caller's result on scatter after this change.
  - The renderer places one entry and notes the rest.
  - The numeric-value guard returns before it places anything, because scatter is not in `SERIES_ONLY_CHART_TYPES`. Its answer is unchanged.
  - The normalizer binds a series derived from an entry after the first to the one slot drawn.
  - At base the two disagreed. With `yAxis: [{ title: 'Primary' }, { field: 'units' }]` and no series, the normalizer set `yAxis: 'right'` on the series, but the chart drew it against the one axis, on the left, titled `Primary`.
- **H3:** the note channel uses no i18n catalogue. Every `data-chart-note` sentence is a JSX English literal. The only catalogue string in the scatter arm is `chart.scatterOneMeasure`, on the refusal. The scatter sentence adds one English clause in that same convention and no catalogue key (`check:i18n-keys` is green).
- **H4: confirmed.** Without authored `series`, the derived series still refuse (`scatter-multi-series`), and the refusal DOM is byte-identical to base.

## Tests (union re-run on merge head `aba42ccff`; implementation commit `1dd700434`)

- New pin `ChartRenderer.scatterYAxisUndrawn-10721.test.tsx`:
  - On base, before the implementation: `4 failed | 3 passed (7)`, VERDICT command-exit 1.
  - Committed-state base swap (BASE blobs `9ce23ae5` / `b3ad9f35` swapped in, then restored to HEAD blobs `a1daaf9f` / `56d0ff1e`, `git diff HEAD` empty): `4 failed | 3 passed (7)`, exit 1. The 3 green are exactly the three controls.
- Ablations through `ablation-replace.mjs`. Each anchor hit once, and each file was restored to its HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty. The pin imports source, so no `dist/` leg applies.
  - A1 forces the undrawn scatter binding to `'right'`: `3 failed | 4 passed (7)`, the predicted rows.
  - A2 forces the renderer's one-axis branch off: `2 failed | 5 passed (7)`, the predicted rows.
- Throwaway DOM-dump probe (deleted, never committed), base vs head, 42 cases:
  - 38 are byte-identical in DOM and in normalizer output. These are all 30 cases on bar, line, area, combo and `horizontal-bar` (1 to 4 entries, derived and authored series, position conflict, first entry at `right`), plus pie, donut, funnel, radar and every one-entry scatter (including `position` `right` and `top`).
  - The 2 scatter refusal renders are byte-identical in DOM. Only their inert derived binding moved from `'right'` to `'left'`.
  - The 2 scatter note renders embed the base plot byte for byte, and add the footnote wrapper and the notes.
- Suite: `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-charts/ --maxWorkers=2` (os-verify-lock) passed on `1dd700434` and on `aba42ccff`: Test Files `82 passed (82)`, Tests `964 passed (964)`, VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Type-check: `pnpm turbo run type-check --filter @object-ui/plugin-charts --concurrency=2` passed on both heads: `Tasks: 10 successful, 10 total`, 0 `error TS`, VERDICT 0. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` lists both pins (count 1 each).
- eslint on the 4 changed TS files (plain): exit 0, 0 errors, 49 warnings. Narrowing proof:
  - `--format json` covers 4 files.
  - Each source file's per-rule tally equals its BASE blob read through `--stdin`. `AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` has 39 `no-explicit-any`, 4 `exhaustive-deps` and 1 `preserve-manual-memoization`. `normalizeChartSchema.ts` has 5 `no-explicit-any`. Both pins have 0.
  - `--print-config` shows `parserOptions` `{}`. Linting is not type-aware, so untouched files cannot move.
- Gates, all exit 0 on `aba42ccff`:
  - The lead list: `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:i18n-keys`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check-changeset-presence` (4 source files of 1 released package, 1 changeset).
  - `check:changeset-claims` asked for a read of the 7546 and 7694 changeset paragraphs. Both describe `normalizeSeries` series keys, which this diff does not touch, and both are still true.
  - Added by the docs and changeset edits: `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-overwrite`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-doc-links`, `check:doc-types`, `check:prompt-keys`, `check:doc-example-ids`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:shell-escape-residue`, `check:doc-example-readers`, `check-doc-expression-carriage`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:docs-route-closure`.
  - `check-governed-queue-guard --test` on the 6 paths: NOT GOVERNED.
- NOT MEASURED:
  - `check:doc-snippets` / `check:doc-examples`. Reason: they need a scoped package build first. The docs edit is prose outside any fence.
  - A real-browser render. Reason: the pins run in the jsdom harness only.
  - The repo-wide `pnpm lint`. Reason: it belongs to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- `.changeset/10691-third-yaxis-note.md` (pending) ends: a `scatter` chart (it draws one y axis) renders as before. That sentence describes objectui#10691's own change. In the release that carries both changesets, a scatter with two or more entries gains a note. I left it untouched, because it is another card's declaration and `check-changeset-overwrite` reports any such edit. This changeset says it completes that half instead. Carrier: none named; the seat decides.
- The claim's file surface did not list `content/docs/plugins/plugin-charts.mdx`. One sentence was added there under AGENTS.md #2 (docs-driven). None of the 11 open PRs read before this PR opened touches it, or any other file here.
- The objectui#10691 pin edit (two call sites) only follows the signature change. No assertion moves.
